title: 電気機器Ⅱ
subtitle: Electrical Machinery II
teachers:
FUKAMI Tadashi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)Learn basic theories of induction machines, such as principles, structures, operating characteristics, starting methods, and speed controls.
(2)Learn basic theories of synchronous machines, such as principles, structures, operating characteristics, and starting methods.
advice:
This is the second course in the series of Electrical Machinery.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Induction machines,
2. Synchronous machines.

Students are required to actively participate in class.
books: Electric Machinery and Apparatus Studies, CORONA publishing co., LTD.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the principle and structure of induction machines and to calculate their performance.
Be able to understand the principle and structure of synchronous machines and to calculate their performance.
Be able to explain the starting methods of synchronous motors.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)Fully understand the principle and structure of induction machines and calculate their operating characteristics.
(2)Fully understand the principle and structure of synchronous machines and calculate their operating characteristics.
(3)Fully understand the starting methods of synchronous motors and explain them.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Understand the principle and structure of induction machines and calculate their operating characteristics.
(2)Understand the principle and structure of synchronous machines and calculate their operating characteristics.
(3)Understand the starting methods of synchronous motors and explain them.
